title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit semantic grounding from large-scale pretraining and perform competently across in-distribution manipulation tasks. This grounding, however, is built on static image-text pairs, whereas manipulation is a continuous, contact-rich process whose dynamics this pretraining cannot capture. We present World Pilot, a VLA framework that augments the policy with priors from a World-Action Model (WAM), routed into the decision chain through two complementary pathways. Latent Steering conditions the perception layer on a scene-evolution latent, and Action Steering supplies an anticipated trajectory as a motion prior to the action generator. Together the two priors equip the VLA with an anticipated view of the scene and a trajectory-level motion hint alongside its semantic conditioning, and the scene-evolution prior remains effective even when supplied by a video-pretrained world model that has not been action-post-trained. World Pilot attains a state-of-the-art Total success rate of 84.7% on the LIBERO-Plus zero-shot OOD benchmark and the highest success rate on every real-robot setting across four manipulation tasks, with the largest margins under shifts in viewpoint, geometry, deformable state, and pose. Project Website: https://world-pilot.github.io/
tldr: World Pilot augments Vision-Language-Action models with world-action priors from a World-Action Model, using latent and action steering to improve zero-shot OOD manipulation, achieving SOTA on LIBERO-Plus and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: World Pilot 通过世界-动作模型的潜空间和动作引导，增强视觉-语言-动作模型，在零样本 OOD 操作任务中达到 SOTA。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型继承了大规模预训练中的语义基础能力，并在分布内操作任务中表现良好。然而，这种语义基础建立在静态图像-文本对之上，而操作是一个连续的、高接触密度的过程，其动态特性无法通过此类预训练捕捉。我们提出World Pilot，一种VLA框架，通过两种互补路径将世界-动作模型（WAM）的先验知识注入决策链。潜在引导（Latent Steering）利用场景演化潜变量对感知层进行条件化，动作引导（Action Steering）则提供一条预期轨迹作为动作生成器的运动先验。这两种先验共同赋予VLA对场景的预期视角、轨迹层面的运动提示以及语义条件，并且即便由未经过动作后训练的视频预训练世界模型提供，场景演化先验依然有效。World Pilot在LIBERO-Plus零样本OOD基准测试中达到了84.7%的最优总成功率，并在四项操作任务的每个真实机器人设置中均取得最高成功率，在视角、几何、可变形状态及位姿偏移场景下优势最为显著。项目网站：https://world-pilot.github.io/

title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can describe scenes and reason about them in language, yet still struggle to ground their actions in the dense 3D world around them. Existing approaches either inject features from a frozen 3D foundation model without an objective that ensures the policy uses them, or constrain geometry with sparse box and map losses that provide no dense spatial signal. We introduce VLGA, the first vision-language-action model supervised to reconstruct the dense 3D world it drives through. VLGA introduces geometry as a fourth modality alongside vision, language, and action through a dedicated expert supervised by a per-pixel pointmap regression loss against LiDAR. Extensive experiments conducted on challenging nuScenes and Bench2Drive datasets for open-loop and closed-loop evaluations, respectively, show the superiority of VLGA over counterpart VLA methods. In particular, on open-loop nuScenes, VLGA sets a new state of the art among VLA methods without ego status, with the lowest L2 (0.50\,m average) and 3-second collision rate (0.18\%). On closed-loop Bench2Drive, VLGA attains the state-of-the-art driving score of 79.08, +0.71 over the strongest prior VLA, at comparable efficiency and comfort.
tldr: VLGA introduces geometry as a fourth modality in VLA models for autonomous driving, supervised by a per-pixel pointmap regression loss against LiDAR, achieving state-of-the-art open-loop and closed-loop driving performance.
tldr_zh: VLGA在自动驾驶的VLA模型中引入几何作为第四模态，通过逐像素点图回归损失（监督于LiDAR）进行训练，在开环和闭环驾驶任务中均取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够描述场景并通过语言进行推理，但在将动作锚定于周围稠密的三维世界时仍面临挑战。现有方法要么从冻结的三维基础模型中注入特征，却缺乏确保策略使用这些特征的目标函数；要么通过稀疏的边界框和地图损失约束几何结构，无法提供稠密的空间信号。我们提出VLGA，这是首个受监督学习以重构其行驶途中稠密三维世界的视觉-语言-动作模型。VLGA将几何作为第四模态引入，与视觉、语言和动作并列，通过专用专家模块实现，该模块受基于激光雷达的逐像素点图回归损失监督。在具有挑战性的nuScenes数据集（开环评估）和Bench2Drive数据集（闭环评估）上进行的大量实验表明，VLGA相较于同类VLA方法具有优越性。特别是在开环nuScenes测试中，VLGA在不依赖自车状态的情况下，创下VLA方法的新最佳记录，取得了最低的L2误差（平均0.50米）和3秒碰撞率（0.18%）。在闭环Bench2Drive测试中，VLGA以79.08的最优驾驶得分达到领先水平，较此前最强的VLA方法提升0.71分，且效率与舒适性相当。

title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/
tldr: TacCoRL injects tactile feedback into VLA policies via sim-real co-training and RL, improving contact-rich manipulation without large-scale tactile pretraining.
tldr_zh: TacCoRL通过仿真-真实协同训练和强化学习将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，在不需大规模触觉预训练的情况下提升了接触丰富的操作任务性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操控提供了强大的视觉、语言和动作先验知识，但仅凭视觉观测往往缺失接触密集型任务所需的局部接触状态。我们提出TacCoRL——一个可扩展的框架，通过将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，并借助仿真-现实联合训练与基于仿真的强化学习（RL）来优化策略，无需大规模的触觉预训练或广泛的实际接触探索。其核心思想不仅在于将触觉作为输入引入，更在于学习在接近失败状态时接触读数应如何调节动作响应——这些状态在示范数据中极少出现，且在硬件上收集具有较高风险。我们使用真实对齐的仿真器作为接触交互的闭环训练环境。混合仿真与真实轨迹首先对预训练策略中的触觉条件化动作进行热启动。基于可验证任务奖励的强化学习随后通过仿真接触滚转优化策略，强化能触发任务完成的触觉条件化动作，同时利用真实轨迹上的监督目标使优化后的策略锚定于部署时的视觉、触觉和动作分布。最终策略可直接迁移至真实机器人，无需特权仿真状态或在线真实世界强化学习。在四项双臂接触密集型任务中，最终视觉-触觉策略的平均成功率达到72.5%，而基线方法为50.0%。结果视频及更多细节详见https://tac-corl.github.io/。

title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
summary: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like $π_{0.5}$ across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.
tldr: Embodied-R1.5 is a unified 8B Embodied Foundation Model that integrates reasoning, planning, and closed-loop correction, achieving SOTA on 16/24 embodied VLM benchmarks and outperforming leading VLA models in manipulation via efficient fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: Embodied-R1.5是一个统一的80亿参数具身基础模型，集成了推理、规划与闭环校正能力，在24个具身VLM基准中16个达到最优，并通过高效微调在操作任务上超越领先的VLA模型。
summary_zh: 我们推出Embodied-R1.5，这是一个统一的具身基础模型（EFM），将涵盖具身认知、任务规划、纠错与指向等全方位具身推理能力集成于单一架构之中，旨在迈向通用物理智能。通过利用三条自动化数据构建管线，大幅拓展关键能力的数据覆盖范围，我们构建了超过150亿词元的大规模数据系统，并设计了多任务均衡的强化学习方案以缓解异构任务冲突。进一步地，我们提出了规划器-接地器-纠错器（PGC）闭环框架，使单一模型能够自主执行长程任务并进行自我修正。仅凭80亿参数，Embodied-R1.5便在24项具身视觉语言模型基准测试中的16项上达到最先进水平，超越了Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5和GPT-5.4等领先模型。得益于内化的具身能力，Embodied-R1.5仅需少量数据即可微调为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），在4个主流操作基准套件上超越$π_{0.5}$等领先VLA模型。我们还进行了广泛的零样本真实机器人实验，验证了其在指令跟随、可供性接地、铰接物体操作以及长程复杂任务中的表现，展现了向物理世界的强大泛化能力。我们开源了模型权重、数据集、训练代码以及专为具身任务定制的评估框架EmbodiedEvalKit，以推动EFM领域的未来研究。

title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2
tldr: This paper presents NEXT, a data-driven method for estimating external joint torques without force sensors, and FIRST, a force-informed re-sampling training strategy that improves policy learning on contact-rich manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了NEXT，一种无需力传感器即可估计外部关节力矩的数据驱动方法，以及FIRST，一种力信息重采样训练策略，能够改善接触丰富操作任务中的策略学习。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要力感知能力，但许多机器人手臂因专用力传感器成本高昂而缺乏此类设备。我们提出神经外部扭矩估计方法（NEXT），这是一种无需任何专用力传感器的数据驱动方法，可从仅10分钟的自由运动数据中实现1分钟训练，却能达到与专用关节扭矩传感器相当的估计精度。NEXT使得低成本机械臂具备力反馈遥操作能力，并通过力引导重采样训练（FIRST）改进策略学习——该训练方法在行为克隆过程中对预接触与接触阶段进行过采样。在五项长时程任务中，FIRST的任务完成进度相比先前力感知策略提升超过17%。NEXT与FIRST共同将力感知遥操作及策略学习功能赋予现有机器人，无需额外传感硬件。视频结果与代码见 https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2

title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for embodied agents, with an emerging strategy of scaling test-time compute to improve capability. However, we observe that doing so increases latency, token usage, and FLOPs while yielding uneven, often diminishing gains in downstream success, limiting where embodied agents can be deployed. We argue that choosing when and where to spend test-time compute is central to bringing frontier performance to the real world. We introduce DIRECT, a routing framework that uses multimodal scene context to allocate compute per prompt, improving the success--cost Pareto frontier over fixed model selection. Across three dominant scaling axes, namely chain-of-thought depth, model size, and memory history, our experiments on VLABench and RoboMME show that test-time compute is not a uniform lever: different axes yield qualitatively distinct capability gains. We validate these insights on a physical Franka arm in a DROID setup spanning zero-shot manipulation and long-horizon chaining, where our router matches or exceeds a stronger model's success rate at up to 65% lower average latency. Ultimately, our results show that naively scaling test-time compute is wasteful, and that DIRECT can provide frontier-level embodied planning in robotic systems at a fraction of the cost. Project page can be found at jadee-dao.github.io/direct/.
tldr: DIRECT proposes a routing framework that allocates test-time compute per prompt based on scene context to improve the success-cost Pareto frontier of embodied planners, achieving up to 65% lower latency while matching stronger models.
tldr_zh: DIRECT提出了一种根据场景上下文为每个提示分配测试时计算的路由框架，以改善具身规划器的成功-成本帕累托前沿，在匹配更强模型的同时延迟最高降低65%。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
视觉-语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被部署为具身智能体的高层规划器，其中一种新兴策略是通过扩展测试时计算（test-time compute）来提升能力。然而，我们观察到，这种做法会增加延迟、令牌（token）消耗和FLOPs，同时在下游任务成功率上却带来不均匀且往往递减的增益，从而限制了具身智能体的部署场景。我们认为，选择何时以及何处投入测试时计算，是将前沿性能带入现实世界的关键。我们提出DIRECT框架，一种基于多模态场景上下文为每个提示（prompt）分配计算资源的路由机制，从而在成功率与成本帕累托前沿上优于固定模型选择。在三种主要的扩展轴线上——即思维链深度、模型规模和记忆历史——我们在VLABench和RoboMME上的实验表明，测试时计算并非一种均匀的杠杆：不同轴线会带来性质截然不同的能力增益。我们在一个物理Franka机械臂上验证了这些发现，该机械臂运行于DROID平台，涵盖零样本操作和长周期任务链。在该平台上，我们的路由机制以最高65%的平均延迟降低，达到了与更强模型相当或更优的成功率。我们的最终结果表明，简单地扩大测试时计算是浪费资源的，而DIRECT能够以极低的成本，在机器人系统中实现前沿水平的具身规划。项目页面详见 jadee-dao.github.io/direct/。

title: APT: Action Expert Pretraining Improves Instruction Generalization of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that couple pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with continuous action experts have achieved strong manipulation performance, yet generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) language instructions remains poor. A known challenge is the structural imbalance in VLA data, where language is far less diverse than visual and action content, making policies prone to visual shortcuts. While discrete-action methods mitigate this through vision-language co-training, continuous action experts lack such protection: they start from random initialization and learn entirely from imbalanced data, producing noisy gradients that corrupt the VLM and fail to exploit its language capability. We address this from a Bayesian perspective, factorizing the policy into a language-agnostic Vision-Action (VA) prior and a language-conditioned VLA likelihood, and propose APT, a two-stage training method emphasizing Action expert PreTraining. In Stage 1, the action expert is pretrained as a VA prior on vision-action pairs from a frozen VLM, bypassing the language imbalance. In Stage 2, language tokens are injected through a gated fusion mechanism that integrates VLM features while preserving the learned visuomotor prior. APT applies to mainstream VLA architectures, including the $π$ and GR00T-style architectures. Comprehensive experiments validate that APT achieves consistent gains on unseen instructions and compositional tasks. Project Page: https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/
tldr: This paper introduces APT, a two-stage training method that pretrains the action expert as a vision-action prior before injecting language, improving instruction generalization of VLA policies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出APT，一种两阶段训练方法，通过将动作专家预训练为视觉-动作先验再注入语言，提升了VLA策略对指令的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与连续动作专家模块相结合，已展现出强大的操作性能，但在面对分布外（OOD）语言指令时泛化能力仍然较差。一个已知挑战在于VLA数据存在结构不平衡：语言内容的多样性远低于视觉和动作内容，导致策略容易依赖视觉捷径。尽管离散动作方法通过视觉-语言联合训练缓解了这一问题，但连续动作专家缺乏此类保护：它们从随机初始化开始，完全基于不平衡数据学习，产生的噪声梯度会破坏VLM并使其语言能力无法充分利用。我们从贝叶斯视角出发，将策略分解为与语言无关的视觉-动作（VA）先验和语言条件化的VLA似然，并提出APT——一种强调动作专家预训练的两阶段训练方法。在第一阶段，动作专家作为VA先验，基于冻结VLM的视觉-动作对进行预训练，从而绕开语言不平衡问题。在第二阶段，通过门控融合机制注入语言令牌，该机制在整合VLM特征的同时保留已习得的视觉运动先验。APT可应用于主流VLA架构，包括π风格和GR00T风格架构。综合实验验证了APT在未见指令和组合任务上均能实现一致性能提升。项目页面：https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/

title: Ambient Diffusion Policy: Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Data in Robotics
summary: We propose Ambient Diffusion Policy, a simple and principled method for imitation learning from suboptimal data in robotics. High-quality, task-specific robot data is expensive and time-consuming to collect, while suboptimal datasets with lower-quality or out-of-distribution demonstrations are abundant. Existing methods that co-train on both data sources in robotics often fail to separate the meaningful and the harmful features in the suboptimal samples. In contrast, our method extracts only the useful features by introducing a new axis to co-training in robotics: noise-dependent data usage. Ambient Diffusion Policy restricts the contribution of suboptimal data during training to only the high and low diffusion times. To rigorously justify our approach, we first observe that robot action data exhibits a spectral power law. This induces two important properties on the optimal Diffusion Policy that we exploit: a global-to-local hierarchy and locality. We theoretically formalize this discussion using a simplified model. Our experiments validate Ambient Diffusion Policy on four types of suboptimal action data (noisy trajectories, sim-to-real gap, task mismatch, and large-scale data mixtures) across six tasks. The results show that it effectively learns from arbitrary sources of suboptimal data. Notably, it outperforms existing co-training baselines by up to 33% when scaled to Open X-Embodiment - a large dataset with heterogeneous data quality and unstructured distribution shifts. Overall, Ambient Diffusion Policy increases the utility of suboptimal demonstrations and expands the set of usable data sources in robotics.
tldr: Proposes Ambient Diffusion Policy, a method that selectively uses suboptimal robot demonstration data during diffusion-based imitation learning by restricting its contribution to specific noise levels, improving performance on heterogeneous datasets like Open X-Embodiment.
tldr_zh: 提出环境扩散策略，通过在扩散模仿学习中限制次优机器人示范数据的贡献仅在高噪声和低噪声阶段，从而在异构数据集上提升性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出环境扩散策略（Ambient Diffusion Policy），这是一种从次优机器人数据中进行模仿学习的简洁且原理性的方法。高质量、特定任务的机器人数据收集成本高昂且耗时，而包含低质量或分布外演示的次优数据集则大量存在。现有的在机器人领域对两类数据源进行联合训练的方法，往往难以区分次优样本中有意义与有害的特征。相比之下，我们的方法通过在机器人联合训练中引入一个新的维度——基于噪声的数据使用——仅提取有用特征。环境扩散策略将训练过程中次优数据的贡献限制在高扩散步与低扩散步区间。为严格论证该方法，我们首先观察到机器人动作数据呈现频谱幂律分布。由此导出了最优扩散策略的两个重要性质：全局到局部的层次性与局部性，并对此加以利用。我们通过简化模型在理论上对这一讨论进行了形式化。实验在六项任务上，针对四类次优动作数据（含噪轨迹、仿真到现实差距、任务不匹配以及大规模数据混合）验证了环境扩散策略。结果表明，该方法能够有效学习任意来源的次优数据。值得注意的是，当扩展到Open X-Embodiment——一个数据质量异质、分布变化无结构的大规模数据集——时，其性能比现有联合训练基线方法最高提升33%。总体而言，环境扩散策略提升了次优演示的利用价值，扩展了机器人领域中可用数据源的集合。

title: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
summary: Multi-robot collaboration allows robots to efficiently take on a wide range of tasks, from moving a couch through a doorway to assembling structures on a construction site. However, achieving such coordination in mobile multi-robot settings remains challenging: centralized methods conditioned on the combined observations of a team scale poorly with team size, and decentralized methods that train one policy per robot often require explicit alignment procedures or information sharing at inference time to overcome partial observability. Our key insight is that the visuomotor priors of pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models should enable reactive, decentralized collaboration from each robot's local observations alone, without these inference-time assumptions. We propose CHORUS, a framework that adapts a single VLA backbone to control diverse, multi-robot teams. At inference time, each robot runs an independent copy of CHORUS, conditioned only on its own observations and a robot-identifying prompt. In real-world experiments including mobile tape measurement, library book handovers, and laundry basket lifting, CHORUS achieves a 64% point improvement over decentralized, from-scratch models, improves reactivity to teammate behavior by 40% points, and outperforms centralized baselines. Together, these results show that a shared VLA backbone is capable of achieving decentralized multi-robot collaboration, without per-robot policies or inter-robot communication at inference.
tldr: CHORUS adapts a single pretrained VLA model to control heterogeneous multi-robot teams in a decentralized manner, using only local observations and a robot-identifying prompt, achieving strong real-world collaboration without inter-robot communication.
tldr_zh: CHORUS 将单个预训练 VLA 模型适配到异构多机器人团队的分散控制中，仅依赖局部观测和机器人标识提示，在真实世界中实现了无需机器人间通信的强协作能力。
summary_zh: 多机器人协作使机器人能够高效完成从搬运沙发穿过门廊到在建筑工地上组装结构等多种任务。然而，在移动多机器人场景中实现这种协调仍具挑战性：依赖于团队联合观测的集中式方法会随团队规模扩大而扩展性不佳，而每台机器人独立训练策略的分散式方法通常需要明确的校准流程或推理时的信息共享来克服局部可观测性。我们的关键洞察在于，预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的视觉运动先验应能仅凭每台机器人的局部观测实现反应式、分散式协作，而无需这些推理时的假设。我们提出CHORUS框架，该框架适配单一VLA骨干网络以控制多样化的多机器人团队。推理时，每台机器人运行独立的CHORUS副本，仅依赖自身观测和机器人身份提示。在包括移动卷尺测量、图书馆书籍传递和洗衣篮搬运的真实世界实验中，CHORUS相比从零训练的分散式模型性能提升64个百分点，对队友行为的反应性提高40个百分点，并超越集中式基线。这些结果共同表明，共享的VLA骨干网络能够在推理时无需每台机器人独立策略或机间通信的情况下，实现分散式多机器人协作。

title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a natural language interface to robot control, but the mapping from language to behavior is often brittle and unintuitive: semantically similar instructions can induce drastically different behaviors, while some capabilities may not be elicitable through prompting alone. As a result, both human instructions and zero-shot language models can fail to reliably steer VLAs toward successful task execution. In this work, we propose a framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills these sequences into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns an improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance. We conformalize this improvement head to prevent harmful steering interventions, where the LFP decreases task performance relative to the original instruction on out-of-distribution scenarios. Crucially, our approach operates on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs, requiring neither access to the original training distribution nor fine-tuning of the underlying model. On seen environments, our conformalized LFP improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware. On visual and semantic perturbations, our conformalized LFP has strong harmlessness guarantees, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to search for language sequences that improve VLA model performance, distills them into a test-time language feedback policy, and uses a conformalized improvement head to prevent harmful interventions on out-of-distribution scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，通过搜索改进VLA模型性能的语言序列，将其蒸馏为测试时的语言反馈策略，并使用保形化的改进头来防止在分布外场景中的有害干预。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人控制提供了自然语言接口，但从语言到行为的映射往往脆弱且不直观：语义相似的指令可能引发截然不同的行为，而某些能力可能无法仅通过提示来激发。因此，人工指令与零样本语言模型均难以可靠地引导VLA模型成功完成任务。本文提出一种框架，通过交互式搜索能够提升闭环VLA任务性能的语言序列，将这些序列蒸馏为测试时语言反馈策略（LFP），并学习一个预测语言引导何时能提升性能的改进头（improvement head）。我们对这一改进头进行共形化处理，以阻止有害的引导干预——即当LFP在分布外场景中相对于原始指令降低任务性能时进行干预。关键之处在于，本方法适用于任意冻结的预训练VLA模型，无需访问原始训练分布或对底层模型进行微调。在已知环境中，我们的共形化LFP使基础VLA性能在仿真中提升24.7%，在硬件中提升65.0%。面对视觉与语义扰动，共形化LFP具有强无害性保障，并能产生开环提示未观测到的恢复行为。

title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising route for robot manipulation by using video generation models to model future scene evolution before producing control actions. However, our empirical observations reveal a phenomenon: generating plausible visual futures does not always guarantee the extraction of accurate actions. To diagnose this failure, we conduct action-head attention analysis and causal interventions. We find that the action decoder fails to focus on task-relevant interaction regions and remains sensitive to perturbations in task-irrelevant areas. This reveals a representation mismatch: hidden states optimized for visual reconstruction are not inherently organized in a form useful for low-level action control. In this paper, we propose AGRA, an Action-Grounded Representation Alignment objective that regularizes the world-action interface by aligning intermediate video diffusion features with spatially coherent semantic representations from a foundation visual encoder. We evaluate AGRA on real-world manipulation tasks. Experiments show that AGRA makes world model representations more action-grounded: by focusing the action decoder on the correct interaction regions, it improves object localization accuracy and affordance understanding, and makes the policy more robust to perturbations in task-irrelevant regions. As a result, AGRA consistently improves both in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization over the baseline world action model.
tldr: AGRA improves world action models by aligning video diffusion features with semantic representations, enhancing action decoder focus on task-relevant regions for more robust robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: AGRA 通过将视频扩散特征与语义表示对齐，改进了世界动作模型，使动作解码器更关注任务相关区域，从而提升机器人操作的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过利用视频生成模型在生成控制动作前对场景的未来演变进行建模，为机器人操作提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，我们的实验观察揭示了一个现象：生成可信的视觉未来并不总能保证提取出准确的动作。为诊断这一失败，我们进行了动作头注意力分析与因果干预实验。研究发现，动作解码器未能聚焦于与任务相关的交互区域，且对任务无关区域的扰动保持敏感。这暴露了表征不匹配问题：为视觉重建优化的隐藏状态并未天然组织成适用于低级动作控制的形式。本文提出AGRA——一种基于动作的表征对齐目标，通过将中间视频扩散特征与基础视觉编码器中空间连贯的语义表征对齐，对世界-动作接口进行正则化。我们在真实世界操作任务上评估了AGRA。实验表明，AGRA使世界模型表征更贴近动作导向：通过引导动作解码器关注正确的交互区域，它提升了目标定位精度与功能理解能力，并使策略对任务无关区域的扰动更具鲁棒性。最终，AGRA在分布内性能与分布外泛化能力上均持续超越基线世界动作模型。

title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the vast majority of pre-trained pipelines remain strictly confined to low-DoF parallel grippers. Adapting these rich semantic priors to high-DoF dexterous hands introduces a severe morphology gap, direct end-to-end joint fine-tuning inherently causes catastrophic forgetting of spatial reasoning and acute action manifold collapse due to data scarcity. In this paper, we present InDex, a novel, data-efficient adaptation framework rooted in cross-morphology semantic inheritance. Rather than discarding the pre-trained 1-DoF parallel grasp output, we repurpose it as a continuous, macroscopic virtual grasp intent proxy to sequentialize the control topology. We implement a two-stage decoupled learning architecture: the first stage parameter-efficiently aligns the VLA backbone to predict continuous arm trajectories and the scalar grasp intent; the second stage freezes this spatial backbone and leverages an intent-conditioned denoising diffusion head to decode fine-grained joint articulations for multi-fingered end-effectors. Extensive simulation benchmarks across a suite of multi-stage, contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks demonstrate that InDex effectively masters intricate skills with minimal demonstration data, substantially outperforming monolithic baselines while preserving the robust spatial generalizability of the original VLA prior.
tldr: InDex adapts VLA models from parallel grippers to dexterous hands by repurposing gripper outputs as intent priors and using a two-stage decoupled architecture with intent-conditioned diffusion, preserving spatial reasoning while enabling data-efficient multi-fingered manipulation.
tldr_zh: InDex 通过将夹爪输出重用作意图先验，并采用两阶段解耦架构与意图条件扩散，使 VLA 模型从平行夹爪适应灵巧手，在保留空间推理能力的同时实现数据高效的多指操作。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力，然而绝大多数预训练管线仍严格局限于低自由度平行夹爪。将这些丰富的语义先验适配至高自由度灵巧手会引入严重的形态鸿沟：直接的端到端联合微调本质上会导致空间推理的灾难性遗忘，并因数据匮乏而引发尖锐的动作流形坍缩。本文提出InDex——一种基于跨形态语义继承的高效数据适配框架。我们并非丢弃预训练的单自由度平行抓取输出，而是将其重新用作连续的、宏观的虚拟抓取意图代理，以序列化控制拓扑结构。我们实现了一种两阶段解耦学习架构：第一阶段以参数高效方式对齐VLA主干网络，使其预测连续机械臂轨迹与标量抓取意图；第二阶段冻结该空间主干网络，并利用基于意图条件的去噪扩散解码头为多指末端执行器解码细粒度关节运动。跨一系列多阶段、高接触灵巧操作任务的仿真基准测试表明，InDex能以极少的演示数据有效掌握复杂技能，显著超越单一整体基线模型，同时保留原始VLA先验的鲁棒空间泛化能力。

title: Action-Effect Memory Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
summary: We present AEM, an Action-Effect Memory pretraining framework for robot manipulation that learns compact temporal representations from vision-action history. Unlike prior robot representation pretraining methods that mainly focus on single-frame visual encoding, AEM targets the temporal nature of manipulation, where the current observation alone is often insufficient under partial observability. AEM models manipulation as an action-driven interaction process by interleaving visual and action features and applying masked modeling to recover missing content from incomplete histories, thereby learning action-conditioned state evolution. The Mamba-encoded output of the final vision token is used as a compact history representation, serving as the global context for decoding and downstream control. This design preserves a single-vector temporal bottleneck while keeping inference efficient. We evaluate AEM with Diffusion Policy and Flow Policy. AEM consistently improves manipulation performance in both simulation and real-world settings, outperforming baselines across clean scenes, cluttered and random scenes, and non-Markovian tasks. Ablation studies further show that history-aware pretraining surpasses single-frame pretraining and direct frame stacking, while reducing inference latency and computational cost.
tldr: AEM pretrains a temporal representation from vision-action history using masked modeling and a Mamba-based single-vector bottleneck, improving robot manipulation policies like Diffusion Policy and Flow Policy in simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: AEM 通过掩码建模和基于 Mamba 的单向量瓶颈从视觉-动作历史中预训练时序表示，提升了 Diffusion Policy 和 Flow Policy 等机器人操作策略在仿真和真实场景中的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：本文提出AEM（Action-Effect Memory，动作-效果记忆）预训练框架，用于机器人操作任务，该框架能从视觉-动作历史中学习紧凑的时间表征。与以往主要关注单帧视觉编码的机器人表征预训练方法不同，AEM针对操作任务的时间特性设计——在部分可观测条件下，仅凭当前观测往往信息不足。AEM将操作建模为动作驱动的交互过程，通过交错排列视觉与动作特征并应用掩码建模，从缺失历史中恢复内容，从而学习动作条件下的状态演化。最终视觉标记经Mamba编码后的输出作为紧凑的历史表征，为解码及下游控制提供全局上下文。该设计在保持高效推理的同时保留了单向量时间瓶颈。我们基于扩散策略与流策略对AEM进行评估。在仿真与实际场景中，AEM均持续提升操作性能，在干净场景、杂乱随机场景及非马尔可夫任务中均优于基线方法。消融研究进一步表明，具有历史感知的预训练优于单帧预训练及直接帧堆叠方法，同时可降低推理延迟与计算成本。

title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a controlled isolation study of recurrence in a strong pretrained VLA backbone. Our formulation augments the transformer with a small set of learnable memory tokens carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end to end with truncated backpropagation through time, with no auxiliary losses and no architectural changes. We instantiate this as $μ$VLA, a family of OpenVLA-OFT variants parameterized by memory width m, TBPTT length K, and the memory update rule (cross-step gradients or a detached EMA), so that recurrence is the only varying factor. On MIKASA-Robo, $μ$VLA improves average success rate on five training tasks from 0.42 to 0.84 at the strongest setting and reaches 0.23 on held-out tasks with the same memory structure versus 0.07 for the memoryless baseline. On tasks requiring different memory structure, performance remains near baseline. On LIBERO, the strongest recurrent variant achieves 96.2% average success, indicating no regression under full observability. We interpret these results as a calibration of the capability envelope of minimal in-backbone recurrence, identifying the regime in which it is sufficient and the regime where additional memory structure is required. Demos and videos can be found in https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/.
tldr: This paper presents a controlled isolation study of minimal in-backbone recurrence for VLA models under partial observability, augmenting a pretrained transformer with learnable memory tokens and showing significant improvements on manipulation tasks without auxiliary losses or architectural changes.
tldr_zh: 本文对VLA模型在部分可观测条件下的最小化骨干递归进行了受控隔离研究，通过在预训练Transformer中添加可学习记忆token，在无需辅助损失或架构修改的情况下显著提升了操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基于当前观测预测未来动作片段，这一假设在部分可观测条件下失效——此时决策依赖于已不可见的信息。现有的记忆增强型VLA模型同时引入了循环机制、检索、压缩模块、辅助目标、分层记忆或特定任务的结构调整，导致循环机制本身的贡献与外围组件相互纠缠。我们针对一个强大的预训练VLA主干网络开展了对循环机制的受控隔离研究。该方法通过一组跨时间步传递、经自注意力机制更新的可学习记忆令牌增强Transformer，采用含截断时间反向传播的端到端训练，不引入任何辅助损失或架构变更。我们将其实例化为$μ$VLA——一组由记忆宽度m、TBPTT长度K及记忆更新规则（跨步梯度或解耦EMA）参数化的OpenVLA-OFT变体，使得循环机制成为唯一的变量因素。在MIKASA-Robo平台上，$μ$VLA在最强配置下将五项训练任务的平均成功率从0.42提升至0.84，并在保持相同记忆结构的保留任务上达到0.23（无记忆基线为0.07）。对于需要不同记忆结构的任务，性能保持接近基线水平。在LIBERO平台上，最强循环变体实现96.2%的平均成功率，表明在完全可观测条件下无性能退化。我们将这些结果解读为对最小化主干内循环机制能力边界的校准，标识出其充分有效的域界以及需要额外记忆结构的场景。演示与视频参见https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/。

title: VICX: Generalizable Robot Manipulation via Video Generation and In-Context Operator Network
summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires not only task-level reasoning over unseen scenes, but also reliable grounding of visual plans into embodiment-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we propose VICX (Video generation and In-Context eXecution), a decoupled closed-loop manipulation framework. In VICX, a frozen video generation model produces vision-language-conditioned high-level visual plans, while a Video-to-Trajectory In-Context Operator Network (V2T-ICON) serves as the task-agnostic interface that grounds these plans into executable robot-state trajectories. To improve execution generalization, V2T-ICON operates on segmentation-extracted arm-only frame observations and uses retrieved image-state pairs as in-context prompts, allowing a robust and generalizable visual-to-state mapping at inference time without parameter updates. Experiments on Meta-World show that VICX supports cross-task generalization, closed-loop self-correction, and cross-embodiment transfer, demonstrating dual generalization across both task semantics and robot execution. The project webpage can be found here: https://scaling-group.github.io/vicx/.
tldr: VICX proposes a decoupled robot manipulation framework that combines a frozen video generation model for high-level visual planning with a Video-to-Trajectory In-Context Operator Network (V2T-ICON) to ground plans into executable trajectories, enabling cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization.
tldr_zh: VICX 提出了一种解耦的机器人操作框架，结合冻结的视频生成模型进行高层视觉规划，以及视频到轨迹的上下文操作网络 (V2T-ICON) 将规划转化为可执行的轨迹，支持跨任务和跨本体的泛化。
summary_zh: 可泛化的机器人操作不仅需要针对未见场景的跨任务推理能力，还需将视觉计划可靠地映射为具体具身执行指令。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出VICX（视频生成与情境内执行）——一种解耦的闭环操作框架。在VICX中，冻结的视频生成模型产生视觉-语言条件化的高层级视觉计划，而视频到轨迹的情境内操作算子网络（V2T-ICON）作为任务无关的接口，将这些计划转化为可执行的机器人状态轨迹。为提升执行泛化性，V2T-ICON基于分割提取的机械臂局部观测，并利用检索到的图像-状态对作为情境内提示，从而在推理阶段无需参数更新即可实现鲁棒且可泛化的视觉到状态映射。Meta-World实验表明，VICX支持跨任务泛化、闭环自纠错及跨具身迁移，在任务语义与机器人执行两个维度上实现了双重泛化。项目页面见：https://scaling-group.github.io/vicx/。

title: DuoBench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Bimanual Manipulation in Simulation and the Real World
summary: Bimanual robot systems substantially expand manipulation capabilities, but coordinating two arms introduces additional control complexity and failure modes that are not well captured by existing benchmarks. We introduce DuoBench, an extensible benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform. DuoBench comprises eleven tasks spanning four coordination categories, implemented in simulation and partially reproduced in the real world through reproducible task recipes with 3D-printable assets. In addition, we propose a stage-based evaluation scheme that supports fine-grained semantic failure analysis beyond binary success and provide human-teleoperated datasets for all benchmark tasks. We benchmark several dual-arm imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies in simulation and on real hardware. Our results show that current policies remain challenged by bimanual manipulation, particularly in early interaction stages, parallel arm execution, and transfer between simulation and real-world settings. DuoBench provides a reproducible testbed for diagnosing these failure modes and studying future methods for dual-arm policy learning. Code, datasets, and videos are available at https://duobench.github.io/
tldr: DuoBench introduces a reproducible benchmarking framework with 11 bimanual manipulation tasks in simulation and real world, evaluates dual-arm policies including VLA models, and reveals current policy failures in coordination and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: DuoBench 提出了一个包含11个双臂操作任务的可复现基准测试框架，在仿真和真实世界中评估了包括VLA模型在内的双臂策略，揭示了当前策略在协调和仿真到现实迁移中的失败模式。
summary_zh: 双臂机器人系统显著扩展了操作能力，但双臂协调引入了额外的控制复杂性和故障模式，现有基准测试未能充分涵盖这些因素。我们提出DuoBench——一个基于FR3 Duo平台的可扩展双臂操作策略基准测试框架。DuoBench包含涵盖四类协调任务的十一个任务，在仿真环境中实现，并通过可复现的任务方案及3D打印资源在现实世界中部分复现。此外，我们提出了一种基于阶段的评估方案，支持超越二元成功判断的细粒度语义故障分析，并为所有基准任务提供了人类遥操作数据集。我们在仿真环境和真实硬件上对多种双臂模仿学习策略及视觉-语言-动作策略进行了基准测试。结果表明，现有策略在处理双臂操作时仍面临挑战，尤其在早期交互阶段、双臂并行执行以及仿真与现实环境之间的迁移方面。DuoBench为诊断这些故障模式以及研究未来的双臂策略学习方法提供了可复现的试验平台。代码、数据集和视频可通过https://duobench.github.io获取。

title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
summary: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.
tldr: This paper proposes a Real2Sim2Real tactile policy learning framework for blind dexterous grasping, combining tactile calibration, layout-aware tactile encoding, and diffusion-based policy aggregation to achieve real-world grasping without vision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种真实到仿真再到真实的触觉策略学习框架，通过触觉校准、布局感知触觉编码和扩散策略聚合，实现无需视觉的盲抓取。
summary_zh: 灵巧手的盲抓是一项关键的操控能力。然而，由于触觉仿真到现实的差距以及稀疏触觉信号的有限表达能力，为真实机器人学习此类仅依赖触觉的策略仍然具有挑战性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种可在物理多指机器人手上部署的纯触觉盲抓框架。我们的方法结合了三个关键组件。首先，我们引入了一种Real2Sim触觉校准流程，构建了一个能够复现真实触觉信号的接触校准数字孪生仿真器。其次，我们通过布局感知触觉编码器改进了稀疏触觉观测的表达能力，该编码器通过自监督预训练融入了传感器几何先验。第三，为提升对未见物体的泛化能力，我们在校准后的仿真器中训练了物体特定的强化学习专家，并将其成功的抓取轨迹聚合为触觉条件扩散策略。我们在配备分布式触觉传感的物理LEAP手上，对10个见过和10个未见过的物体进行了评估。部署的策略在全部20个物体上实现了27%的真实世界抓取成功率，无需真实抓取演示或视觉输入。仿真消融实验表明，布局感知触觉预训练提升了抓取性能，而传感层级的评估确认Real2Sim校准增强了仿真与硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。综合这些结果，接触事件校准、几何感知触觉表征学习以及基于扩散的策略聚合，为在真实灵巧机器人手上实现纯触觉盲抓提供了一条有效路径。项目页面：Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io。

title: Learning to Assist: Collaborative VLAs for Implicit Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) combines the complementary strengths of humans and robots to improve task efficiency. However, many existing collaborative systems rely on hand-engineered pipelines, limiting their scalability and flexibility for new tasks. In this work, we show that models trained end-to-end with imitation learning, specifically vision-language-action (VLA) models, can support collaborative manipulation, and characterize the key factors affecting their real-world performance. We evaluate two state-of-the-art models and identify a failure mode of action-chunking policies in implicit HRC, where demonstration action leakage (i.e., action chunks crossing latent task transitions) can cause premature assistive behavior. We find that this issue increases with longer execution horizons and occurs in real-world collaborative VLA systems, such as when a robot attempts to hand over a tool before the person is ready. We propose an inference-time steering method to mitigate these erroneous assistive actions while preserving policy performance. Finally, through a 16-participant user study on a long-horizon collaborative assembly task, we show that steering enables a longer execution horizon while mitigating premature assistance, leading to faster collaboration and fewer failures compared to a shorter-horizon policy.
tldr: This paper investigates vision-language-action (VLA) models for implicit human-robot collaboration, identifies action-chunking failure modes, and proposes an inference-time steering method to mitigate premature assistance, validated in a user study on long-horizon assembly.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在人机协作中的应用，揭示了动作分块策略导致的过早协助问题，并提出了一种推理时引导方法，通过用户实验证明了其在长周期协作任务中的有效性。
summary_zh: 人机协作（HRC）结合了人类与机器人的互补优势，以提升任务效率。然而，现有许多协作系统依赖于手工设计的流水线，限制了其在新任务中的可扩展性与灵活性。本研究证明，通过模仿学习进行端到端训练的模型（特别是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）能够支持协作操作，并揭示了影响其真实世界性能的关键因素。我们评估了两类最先进模型，识别出隐式HRC中动作分块策略的一种失效模式：示范动作泄漏（即动作分块跨越潜在任务转换边界）可能导致过早的辅助行为。研究发现，这一问题随执行时域增长而加剧，并出现在真实世界的协作VLA系统中（例如机器人试图在人类未准备好时移交工具）。我们提出了一种推理时引导方法，在保持策略性能的同时减少此类错误辅助动作。最后，通过一项16名参与者参与的长时间协作装配任务用户研究，我们证明该方法在缓解过早辅助行为的同时实现了更长的执行时域，相较于短时域策略，协作速度更快且失败率更低。

title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
summary: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.
tldr: LUCID learns task intent from unstructured internet human videos and maps it to robot actions via simulation-trained sensorimotor policies, enabling zero-shot skill transfer to different embodiments like a dexterous hand or parallel-jaw gripper.
tldr_zh: LUCID 从互联网非结构化人类视频中学习任务意图，并通过仿真训练的感觉运动策略将其映射为机器人动作，实现灵巧手或平行夹爪等不同实体的零样本技能迁移。
summary_zh: 目前最广泛采用的机器人学习流程，通常依赖机器人演示或结构化人类数据进行技能学习。这类数据采集成本高昂，且与特定机器人本体绑定。相比之下，非结构化人类视频提供了一种可扩展的替代方案：它们包含跨物体、场景和策略的多样化操作演示，但无法直接关联机器人动作。我们提出LUCID框架——一个两阶段系统：第一阶段从互联网规模数据集的非结构化人类视频中学习任务意图，第二阶段在大规模并行仿真中学习机器人控制。意图模型通过闭环方式，根据当前观测预测短时域意图（即场景下一步应发生什么）。具身特定的感知运动策略将该意图转化为机器人动作。该意图接口在不同控制器间共享，因此同一意图模型可适配不同机器人本体——从我们主用的灵巧手到平行夹爪均可适用。我们在五项真实世界操作任务上评估了LUCID：搅拌、擦拭和分拣任务仅由互联网视频监督，即可零样本迁移至新场景与物体实例；推T形块和电缆布线任务各由1小时自采集智能手机视频监督。项目页面：https://lucid-robot.github.io/。

title: ConsistencyPlanner: Real-time Planning with Fast-Sampling Consistency Models
summary: Closed-loop planning in complex, real-world driving scenarios presents a critical challenge for autonomous driving systems. While traditional rule-based methods are interpretable, their predefined heuristics lack the adaptability for dynamic traffic environments. Learning-based approaches have shown considerable promise. Conversely, learning-based approaches, despite their promise, struggle to balance the modeling diverse and multimodal driving behaviors and real-time planning, often leading to indecisive or unsafe actions. To address this limitation, we propose Consistency Planner, a real-time planning framework with fast-sampling consistency models. Our approach is built upon two key technical contributions. Efficient Multimodal Sampling: We employ fast-sampling consistency models to generate a diverse set of plausible future trajectories. This enables efficient, real-time exploration of multimodal actions, overcoming the computational bottlenecks of previous iterative generative methods. Heterogeneous Feature Fusion: We introduce an attention-enhanced decoder that dynamically integrates heterogeneous input features (including scene feature and action token) into a cohesive representation for robust planning. Extensive evaluation in the Waymax simulator demonstrates superior performance in safety metrics compared to existing methods, with particularly strong results in challenging dynamic scenarios.
tldr: ConsistencyPlanner proposes a real-time driving planning framework using fast-sampling consistency models for efficient multimodal trajectory generation and an attention-enhanced decoder for heterogeneous feature fusion, achieving superior safety in the Waymax simulator.
tldr_zh: ConsistencyPlanner 提出了一种实时驾驶规划框架，利用快速采样一致性模型高效生成多模态轨迹，并通过注意力增强解码器融合异构特征，在Waymax模拟器中实现了更高的安全性。
summary_zh: 在复杂真实驾驶场景中的闭环规划对自动驾驶系统构成一项关键挑战。传统基于规则的方法虽具可解释性，但其预定义的启发式策略难以适应动态交通环境。基于学习的方法已展现出显著潜力。然而，尽管此类方法前景广阔，在建模多样且多模式的驾驶行为与实时规划之间仍难以取得平衡，常导致决策犹豫或行为不安全。为突破这一局限，我们提出一致性规划器（Consistency Planner），一种基于快速采样一致性模型的实时规划框架。该方法建立在两项关键技术贡献之上：高效多模式采样——采用快速采样一致性模型生成多样化的可行未来轨迹集，从而实现对多模式行为的实时高效探索，克服了此前迭代式生成方法的计算瓶颈；异构特征融合——引入注意力增强解码器，将异构输入特征（包括场景特征和行为令牌）动态整合为统一的表示以实现稳健规划。在Waymax模拟器上的大量评估表明，该方法在安全指标上优于现有方法，尤其在具有挑战性的动态场景中表现尤为突出。

title: Adversarial Attacks on Learned Policies for Surgical Robotic Tasks
summary: Learning-based policies are being considered to augment the dexterity of human surgeons in robot-assisted surgery. Can the end-to-end mapping from visual observations to robot actions be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, potentially leading to patient injury? In this paper, we present the first study of adversarial threats to learning-based policies in surgical robotics. We investigate two threat modes: (a) disruptive attacks, where imperceptible visual perturbations interrupt policy execution, and (b) steering attacks, where such perturbations steer policy actions toward attacker-specified directions. We formulate three adversarial attack methods, each with increasing access to policy information, and evaluate their impact on two surgical subtasks: debridement and suturing. Our evaluation covers three end-to-end policy architectures: ACT, Diffusion Policy, and Pi0. In addition, we introduce a new class of photometric adversarial attacks that mimic natural visual changes, such as lighting variations, to generate effective yet visually plausible perturbations. Results from 560 physical experiments using phantoms for debridement and suturing suggest that state-of-the-art policies can be significantly disrupted, resulting in an average 61% reduction in surgical subtask success rates. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/adversary-surgery
tldr: This paper presents the first systematic study of adversarial attacks on vision-based policies for surgical robotic tasks, demonstrating that imperceptible visual perturbations can significantly degrade the success rates of learned policies like ACT, Diffusion Policy, and Pi0 on debridement and suturing subtasks.
tldr_zh: 本文首次系统研究了手术机器人任务中基于视觉策略的对抗攻击，证明微小的视觉扰动可显著降低ACT、Diffusion Policy和Pi0等学习策略在清创和缝合子任务中的成功率。
summary_zh: 基于学习的策略正被考虑用于增强机器人辅助手术中人类外科医生的灵巧性。从视觉观察到机器人动作的端到端映射是否会受到对抗性攻击的威胁，进而可能导致患者受伤？本文首次研究了手术机器人领域中基于学习策略面临的对抗性威胁。我们探究了两种威胁模式：(a) 破坏性攻击，即难以察觉的视觉扰动中断策略执行；(b) 导向性攻击，即此类扰动将策略动作引导至攻击者指定的方向。我们提出了三种对抗性攻击方法，每种方法对策略信息的访问权限逐步增加，并评估了它们对两种手术子任务（清创和缝合）的影响。评估覆盖了三种端到端策略架构：ACT、扩散策略和Pi0。此外，我们引入了一类新的光度对抗性攻击，该攻击模仿自然视觉变化（如光照变化），以生成有效且视觉上合理的扰动。基于使用清创和缝合模型进行的560次物理实验结果表明，最先进的策略可能受到显著干扰，导致手术子任务成功率平均下降61%。项目页面：https://sites.google.com/view/adversary-surgery

title: Learning Object Manipulation from Scratch via Contrastive Interaction
summary: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has seen recent success in a wide variety of goal-conditioned robotics tasks by learning structured representations of the dynamics. However, despite its success in locomotion and simpler control domains, CRL often struggles in interaction-rich manipulation. We argue that a key source of this difficulty is object-centric interaction, such as contact or grasping, that induces distinct changes in the underlying dynamic modes. In this work, we formulate manipulation dynamics as a piecewise-smooth Markov process and show that interaction-induced mode changes create piecewise nonlinear reachability structures that are difficult for standard CRL energy functions to represent and plan over. Based on this analysis, we introduce Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR). IWR performs interaction-aware resampling around phases before, during, and after interactions, encouraging the learned representation to preserve the mode boundaries that determine future reachability to capture multi-modal and piecewise nonlinear reachability. Across interaction-centric environments, including 2D dynamic control, robotic manipulation, and robot air hockey, IWR improves both sample efficiency and overall performance over prior CRL methods, with 19.8% average improvement in simulation. Finally, using a sim-to-real pipeline with policies trained by IWR, we demonstrate the first real-world goal-conditioned robot air hockey agent capable of hitting goals, improving success from 25% to 60%. Project Page: IWR-arxiv.github.io.
tldr: Introduces Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR) to improve Contrastive Reinforcement Learning for object-centric manipulation, achieving better sample efficiency and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 提出交互加权重采样（IWR）来改进对比强化学习在物体中心操作任务中的表现，提升样本效率并实现仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 对比强化学习（CRL）通过学习动力学的结构化表示，在多种目标条件机器人任务中取得了近期成功。然而，尽管在运动控制和简单控制领域表现优异，CRL在富含交互的复杂操作任务中仍面临挑战。我们认为，这一困难的关键来源在于以物体为中心的交互（如接触或抓取），此类交互会引发底层动态模式的显著变化。本研究将操作动力学建模为分段光滑马尔可夫过程，并揭示交互导致的模式变化会形成分段非线性可达性结构，使得标准CRL能量函数难以表征和规划。基于此分析，我们提出交互加权重采样（IWR）。IWR在交互前、交互中及交互后的关键阶段执行交互感知重采样，促使学习到的表征保留决定未来可达性的模式边界，从而捕捉多模态与分段非线性可达性。在涵盖二维动态控制、机器人操作及机器人冰球等交互密集型环境中，IWR相较先前CRL方法在采样效率和整体性能上均有提升，仿真中平均改进率达19.8%。最后，通过采用基于IWR训练策略的仿真到真实迁移流程，我们首次实现了能够完成击球目标的真实世界目标条件机器人冰球智能体，成功率从25%提升至60%。项目页面：IWR-arxiv.github.io。

title: Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction for Chunk-based Robot Policies
summary: Action chunking has become a standard design in modern robot policies, from diffusion/flow policies to vision-language-action models, where the policy predicts a sequence of actions and executes a fixed number of them instead of acting one step at a time. However, this paradigm relies on a key assumption: a fixed execution horizon. During chunk execution, the policy operates open-loop, which is particularly problematic for fine-grained manipulation tasks that require frequent replanning. In practice, the execution horizon is typically chosen through empirical tuning and is highly task-dependent. To this end, we propose Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction (DEHP), an effective method that trains a lightweight execution-horizon prediction branch using online reinforcement learning while keeping the pretrained chunk policy completely frozen. This makes the method compatible with black-box chunk policies and isolates the effect of adapting the execution horizon from changes to the underlying action generator. Across our evaluations, DEHP improves the success rate of different high-precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks by a large margin. Our qualitative analysis further shows that DEHP predicts shorter execution horizons during fine-grained stages of the task and longer horizons during free-space motion. In this way, DEHP balances the efficiency of open-loop chunk execution with the reactivity of closed-loop single-step control. Project page: https://dehp-chunking.github.io/
tldr: DEHP proposes a lightweight online RL branch to dynamically predict the execution horizon for chunk-based robot policies, balancing open-loop efficiency and closed-loop reactivity without modifying the pretrained policy.
tldr_zh: DEHP提出了一种轻量级在线强化学习分支，可动态预测基于块的机器人策略的执行步长，在不改变预训练策略的前提下，平衡开环效率与闭环反应能力。
summary_zh: 动作分块已成为现代机器人策略中的标准设计，从扩散/流动策略到视觉-语言-动作模型，这些策略会预测一系列动作并执行固定数量的动作，而非逐步执行。然而，这一范式依赖一个关键假设：固定的执行步长。在分块执行期间，策略以开环方式运行，这对于需要频繁重新规划的精细操作任务而言尤为棘手。实际应用中，执行步长通常通过经验调参确定，且高度依赖具体任务。为此，我们提出动态执行步长预测（DEHP），该方法在保持预训练分块策略完全冻结的前提下，利用在线强化学习训练一个轻量级的执行步长预测分支。这使得该方法能够兼容黑盒分块策略，并将执行步长的适应效果与底层动作生成器的变化隔离开来。在多项评估中，DEHP显著提升了不同高精度和长时程操作任务的成功率。我们的定性分析进一步表明，DEHP在任务的精细操作阶段预测较短的执行步长，而在自由空间运动阶段预测较长的执行步长。通过这种方式，DEHP平衡了开环分块执行的效率与闭环单步控制的响应性。项目页面：https://dehp-chunking.github.io/

title: PLUME: Probabilistic Latent Unified World Modeling and Parameter Estimation for Multi-Finger Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation with multi-finger hands can be sensitive to physical parameters such as object shape, pose, and friction coefficients. While simulation enables large-scale data collection with known parameter values, simulation-trained policies must still handle uncertainty at deployment, where the true parameters and therefore the true dynamics are unknown. Standard domain randomization strategies may be insufficient for precise tasks like screwdriver turning, as manipulation strategies may need to change depending on specific parameter values. To address this, we propose Probabilistic Latent Unified world Modeling and parameter Estimation (PLUME), a world model that jointly learns to evolve a belief over parameter values as well as the system dynamics conditioned on those parameters. We learn a latent space to jointly represent multiple qualitatively different physical parameters along with rewards, themselves functions of partially-observable variables, to inform planning. Our novel learning framework leads to efficient alignment of the world model to true dynamics through online parameter inference as opposed to re-training or fine-tuning. We evaluate our method on simulated screwdriver turning, valve turning, bucket lifting, and disk flicking tasks, as well as a hardware screwdriver turning task, where we achieve successful zero-shot transfer of our simulation-trained policy and outperform state-of-the-art offline reinforcement learning and world-model-augmented behavior cloning baselines. Please see our website at https://plume-world-model.github.io for videos.
tldr: PLUME proposes a probabilistic latent world model that jointly learns to infer physical parameters and dynamics online, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of multi-finger manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: PLUME提出了一种概率潜在世界模型，通过在线推断物理参数和动力学，实现了多指灵巧操作策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 多指灵巧操作对物理参数（如物体形状、姿态和摩擦系数）较为敏感。虽然仿真环境能够基于已知参数值进行大规模数据采集，但基于仿真训练的策略在部署时仍需处理不确定性——此时真实参数及相应的真实动力学模型均为未知。针对螺丝刀旋转这类精密任务，标准域随机化策略可能不足，因为操作策略需根据特定参数值动态调整。为此，我们提出概率潜在统一世界建模与参数估计（PLUME）——一种能够联合学习参数值信念演化及基于参数的系统动力学的世界模型。我们构建了潜在空间，用以联合表征多个性质不同的物理参数及其相关奖励（这些奖励本身是部分可观测变量的函数），从而为规划提供依据。我们的新型学习框架通过在线参数推断（而非重新训练或微调）实现世界模型与真实动力学的高效对齐。我们在模拟的螺丝刀旋转、阀门旋转、吊桶提升和圆盘弹射任务，以及真实硬件环境下的螺丝刀旋转任务中评估了该方法，实现了仿真训练策略的零样本迁移，并超越了现有最先进的离线强化学习和世界模型增强行为克隆基线方法。相关视频请访问项目网站：https://plume-world-model.github.io。

title: AutoMine Solution for AV2 2026 Scenario Mining Challenge
summary: With the development of autonomous driving systems, mining high-value, safety-critical, and planning-relevant scenarios from large-scale driving logs has become essential for data-driven evaluation. In this paper, we propose AutoMine, a robust self-refining scenario mining method based on LLMs and VLMs. AutoMine uses semantics-preserving prompt augmentation to reduce LLM prompt sensitivity, combines robust trajectory atomic functions with VLM-based functions to handle perception noise and open-world visual cues, and refines generated code through execution feedback from real logs. In the Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Competition at CVPR 2026, AutoMine achieves a HOTA-Temporal score of 36.38 and a Timestamp BA score of 77.21.
tldr: AutoMine is a self-refining scenario mining method using LLMs and VLMs to extract safety-critical driving scenarios from logs, achieving top scores in the Argoverse 2 competition.
tldr_zh: AutoMine 是一种基于 LLM 和 VLM 的自我优化场景挖掘方法，用于从驾驶日志中提取高价值、关键安全场景，在 Argoverse 2 比赛中取得领先成绩。
summary_zh: 随着自动驾驶系统的发展，从大规模驾驶日志中挖掘高价值、安全关键且与规划相关的场景，已成为数据驱动评估的关键。本文提出AutoMine——一种基于大语言模型（LLM）与视觉语言模型（VLM）的鲁棒自优化场景挖掘方法。AutoMine采用语义保留的提示增强技术以降低LLM的提示敏感性，结合鲁棒的轨迹原子函数与基于VLM的函数来处理感知噪声及开放世界视觉线索，并通过真实日志的执行反馈对生成的代码进行优化。在CVPR 2026举办的Argoverse 2场景挖掘竞赛中，AutoMine取得了HOTA-Temporal分数36.38及Timestamp BA分数77.21的成绩。

title: PAWS: Preference Learning with Advantage-Weighted Segments
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) learns policies from human trajectory-level comparisons, avoiding explicit reward design and expert demonstrations. Existing methods typically train utility functions on trajectory or segment-level preferences while relying on per-step utility estimates during policy optimization. This training and inference mismatch induces a distribution shift that severely degrades temporal credit assignment and limits policy learning. We analyze this issue and propose PAWS, a segment-based preference learning method that performs policy updates directly using segment-level advantage functions. By aligning utility training with policy optimization, PAWS preserves trajectory-level preference information and avoids unreliable per-step learning signals. Experiments on simulated robotic manipulation and locomotion tasks demonstrate that PAWS consistently outperforms existing PbRL approaches, highlighting the importance of distribution-consistent preference learning.
tldr: PAWS proposes a segment-based preference learning method that aligns utility training with policy optimization by using segment-level advantage functions, addressing distribution shift and improving temporal credit assignment in PbRL for robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: PAWS提出了一种基于片段的偏好学习方法，通过使用片段级优势函数使效用训练与策略优化对齐，解决了分布偏移问题并改善了时序信用分配，在机器人操作和 locomotion 任务上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）通过人类对轨迹级别的比较来学习策略，从而避免显式的奖励设计和专家示范。现有方法通常基于轨迹或片段级别的偏好训练效用函数，但在策略优化过程中依赖每步的效用估计。这种训练与推理之间的不匹配会导致分布偏移，严重削弱时序信用分配能力并限制策略学习。我们分析了这一问题，并提出了PAWS——一种基于片段的偏好学习方法，该方法直接利用片段级别的优势函数进行策略更新。通过使效用训练与策略优化对齐，PAWS保留了轨迹级别的偏好信息，并避免了不可靠的逐步学习信号。在模拟机器人操作与 locomotion 任务上的实验表明，PAWS始终优于现有的PbRL方法，凸显了分布一致的偏好学习的重要性。

title: Identifiability Without Gaussianity: Symbolic World Models and Near-Infinite Temporal Consistency
summary: Klindt, LeCun, and Balestriero (arXiv:2605.26379) proved that Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) achieve linear identifiability, the linear recovery of the world's true latent variables, if and only if the world's latent dynamics follow a Gaussian, stationary process. This Gaussian boundary implies a fundamental limit on temporal consistency: for any non-Gaussian physical system, the representation error of a statistical World Model grows monotonically with time. We prove that this limit is an artifact of the statistical alignment mechanism, not a property of World Models in general. We introduce the Physics-Grounded Symbolic Architecture (PGSA) and prove three results: (1) a PGSA achieves exact linear identifiability for all physical regimes, regardless of the latent distribution; (2) the per-step error of a PGSA is bounded by numerical precision alone; and (3) as a direct consequence, a PGSA maintains temporal consistency for an unbounded number of transitions, a property we term near-infinite temporal consistency. We further prove that statistical World Models cannot achieve this property for any non-Gaussian system, regardless of model capacity or the volume of training data. The algebraic cores of four of the theorems are formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib4 v4.31.0 (zero sorry placeholders); the Klindt et al. converse is taken as an external premise. The contrast establishes that symbolic grounding in the causal generator of the world's dynamics is the sufficient condition and, in non-Gaussian regimes, the only condition for near-infinite temporal consistency.
tldr: The paper introduces Physics-Grounded Symbolic Architecture (PGSA) to prove that symbolic grounding in causal dynamics, rather than statistical alignment, enables near-infinite temporal consistency in world models, overcoming the Gaussian identifiability limit of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出物理接地符号架构（PGSA），证明符号化因果动力建模而非统计对齐，能实现世界模型的近无限时间一致性，突破了联合嵌入预测架构的高斯可识别性限制。
summary_zh: Klindt、LeCun与Balestriero（arXiv:2605.26379）证明：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）实现线性可识别性（即能够线性恢复世界的真实潜变量）的充要条件是，世界的潜动态遵循高斯平稳过程。这一高斯边界意味着时间一致性的根本极限：对于任何非高斯物理系统，统计世界模型的表征误差随时间单调增长。本文证明该极限源于统计对齐机制的内在特性，而非世界模型的普遍属性。我们提出基于物理的符号架构（PGSA）并证明三项结论：（1）PGSA可在所有物理机制下实现精确线性可识别性，无论潜变量分布为何；（2）PGSA的逐步误差仅受数值精度约束；（3）作为直接推论，PGSA可在无限次状态转移中保持时间一致性，我们将此特性称为近无限时间一致性。进一步证明：无论模型容量或训练数据量如何，统计世界模型均无法在非高斯系统中实现该特性。本文四项定理的代数核心已通过Lean 4与Mathlib4 v4.31.0完成形式化验证（零占位符），Klindt等人的逆命题作为外部前提使用。这种对比表明：在动力学因果生成器中进行符号接地是充分条件，且在非高斯机制下是达成近无限时间一致性的唯一条件。

title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HiL-RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, enabling online policy improvement with human guidance. However, current HiL-RL frameworks remain intervention-intensive, relying on frequent human corrections to redirect the policy out of unproductive exploration, which incurs high labor cost and limits real-world scalability. To address this, we propose UniIntervene, an agentic intervention model that detects unproductive exploration and autonomously recovers the policy toward high-value states, taking over the bulk of interventions from human operators. Specifically, UniIntervene first performs future-conditioned action-value estimation, predicting the latent consequence of the current action and evaluating its induced value, which provides a more stable progress signal. Building on this, a temporal value-risk critic aggregates recent value dynamics and triggers intervention when the estimated value exhibits sustained stagnation or degradation. When intervention is required, UniIntervene retrieves a high-value recovery target from a memory of past intervention episodes and produces executable corrective actions through a goal-conditioned recovery policy. In this way, UniIntervene turns intervention from passive human correction into a value-aware recovery process for efficient real-world RL. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UniIntervene improves the average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
tldr: UniIntervene introduces an agentic intervention model that detects unproductive exploration in real-world robot RL and autonomously recovers the policy, reducing human interventions by 57% while improving success rate by 8.6%.
tldr_zh: UniIntervene 提出了一种代理干预模型，能够检测真实世界机器人强化学习中的无效探索并自主恢复策略，在将人类干预减少57%的同时将成功率提升8.6%。
summary_zh: 人机协同强化学习（HiL-RL）已成为真实世界机器人操作的有效范式，能够通过人类指导实现在线策略优化。然而，现有HiL-RL框架仍存在干预密集的问题，依赖频繁的人类修正来引导策略脱离无效探索，导致人力成本高昂且限制了实际场景的可扩展性。为此，我们提出UniIntervene——一种自主干预模型，能够检测无效探索并自主将策略恢复至高价值状态，从而取代人类操作员的大部分干预。具体而言，UniIntervene首先执行未来条件化的动作价值估计，预测当前动作的潜在后果并评估其诱导价值，从而提供更稳定的进度信号。在此基础之上，时序价值风险评判器聚合近期价值动态，当估计价值呈现持续停滞或恶化时触发干预。当需要干预时，UniIntervene从历史干预片段存储器中检索高价值恢复目标，并通过目标条件化恢复策略生成可执行的修正动作。通过这种方式，UniIntervene将被动的人类修正转化为价值感知的恢复过程，助推高效的真实世界强化学习。在多种真实操作任务上的大量实验表明，与最先进的HiL-RL基线相比，UniIntervene将平均成功率提升8.6%，同时将人类干预减少57%。

title: Fourier Features Let Agents Learn High Precision Policies with Imitation Learning
summary: High-precision robotic manipulation requires fine-grained spatial reasoning that is often difficult to achieve with RGB-only policies due to depth ambiguity and perspective scale issues. Policies that leverage 3D information directly, such as those based on point clouds, offer a stronger geometric prior over purely image-based ones, yet their performance remains highly task-dependent. We hypothesize that this discrepancy may be due to the spectral bias of neural networks towards learning low frequency functions, which especially affects architectures conditioned on slow-moving Cartesian features. We thus propose to map point clouds from Cartesian space into high-dimensional Fourier space, effectively equipping the point cloud encoder with direct access to high-frequency features. We experimentally validate the use of Fourier features on challenging manipulation tasks from the RoboCasa and ManiSkill3 benchmarks and on a real robot setup. Despite their simplicity, we find that Fourier features provide significant benefits across diverse encoder architectures and benchmarks and are robust across hyperparameters. Our results indicate that Fourier features let policies leverage geometric details more effectively than Cartesian features, showing their potential as a general-purpose tool for point cloud-based imitation learning. We provide source code and videos on our project page: https://fourier-il.github.io/fourier-il
tldr: This paper proposes using Fourier features to map point clouds into high-dimensional space, enabling imitation learning policies to better leverage high-frequency geometric details for high-precision robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将点云映射到高维傅里叶空间，使模仿学习策略能更好地利用高频几何细节，实现高精度机器人操作。
summary_zh: 高精度机器人操作需要细粒度的空间推理能力，而由于深度模糊性和视角尺度问题，纯RGB策略往往难以实现这一目标。直接利用三维信息的策略（例如基于点云的策略）相比纯图像策略具有更强的几何先验，但其性能仍高度依赖于具体任务。我们假设这种差异可能源于神经网络倾向于学习低频函数的频谱偏差，这尤其会影响以缓慢变化的笛卡尔特征为条件的架构。因此，我们提出将点云从笛卡尔空间映射到高维傅里叶空间，从而有效赋予点云编码器直接获取高频特征的能力。我们通过RoboCasa和ManiSkill3基准测试中具有挑战性的操作任务以及真实机器人实验平台，对傅里叶特征的使用进行了实验验证。尽管方法简单，但实验发现傅里叶特征在不同编码器架构和基准测试中均能带来显著性能提升，且对超参数具有鲁棒性。研究结果表明，傅里叶特征使策略能够比笛卡尔特征更有效地利用几何细节，展现了其作为基于点云的模仿学习通用工具的潜力。相关源代码与演示视频请访问项目页面：https://fourier-il.github.io/fourier-il

title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.
tldr: DrivingAgent automates the design and real-time scheduling of autonomous driving modules using an LLM-based agent framework, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs on nuScenes and Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: DrivingAgent 利用基于 LLM 的智能体框架，自动化自动驾驶模块的设计与实时调度，在 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 上实现了更优的速度-精度权衡。
summary_zh: 许多自动驾驶系统正越来越多地集成基础模型，以提升泛化能力并处理长尾场景。然而，这一趋势带来了两个关键挑战：（i）人工设计并集成新模型的过程繁琐且劳动密集；（ii）缺乏智能化的动态调度机制来满足严格的实时性要求。尽管基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体为自动化提供了有前景的思路，但现有框架并不适用于自动驾驶场景——具体而言，它们未能区分系统设计与实时调度这两种本质不同的需求，将模块视为不透明的黑箱，且不支持持续运行。为解决这些局限，我们提出了DrivingAgent——一个专为自动驾驶系统设计与调度双重挑战定制的新型智能体框架。在设计阶段，DrivingAgent通过解析系统架构、生成代码，并借助超网络训练验证模块，实现模块开发的自动化。在调度阶段，它采用经强化学习训练的轻量级LLM，配合整合长期存储与带时间戳短期上下文的结构化记忆机制，实时动态编排系统模块。实验结果表明，DrivingAgent在nuScenes和Benchmarks基准测试中均实现了更优的速度-精度权衡。

title: KinematicRL: A Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning Framework For Social Navigation With Kinodynamic Feasibility
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown promise for social navigation, yet its real-world deployment remains hindered by a persistent sim-to-real gap arising from simplified first-order dynamics and context-specific human state estimation pipelines. This work presents a unified framework that addresses these limitations to produce dynamically feasible navigation policies suitable for real-world deployment. First, theoretical analysis reveals that tracking error between simulated and actual robot position decays exponentially with increased control order, motivating the use of higher-order control inputs as DRL action space. A second-order control formulation tailored to differential drive robots is developed, complemented by a stochastic iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) that pretrains the policy via a divergence minimization objective. Second, to avoid the added system complexity of camera-LiDAR fusion, a cluster-based human tracking pipeline using only 2D LiDAR is introduced. Human detections are associated according to both spatial proximity and velocity similarity, enabling reliable differentiation of nearby pedestrians and yielding stable velocity estimates through temporal aggregation. Third, we introduce an unbiased residual gating block to balance reaction- and memory-based behaviors while handling time-varying crowd sizes, both critical for social navigation. The resulting policy, KinematicRL, consistently improves kinematic performance and adapts to varying number of detected humans. Experiments in real-world environments demonstrate that, when combined with the proposed tracking pipeline, KinematicRL can be deployed on a real differential drive robot with minimal modifications.
tldr: This paper proposes a sim-to-real RL framework for social navigation that uses second-order control actions and a 2D LiDAR-based human tracking pipeline to achieve kinodynamically feasible and deployable policies on differential-drive robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于社交导航的仿真到现实强化学习框架，通过二阶控制动作和基于2D激光雷达的行人追踪管线，实现了可在差速驱动机器人上部署的运动学可行策略。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）在社交导航领域展现出潜力，但其实际部署仍受限于由简化的一阶动力学模型和特定场景下人体状态估计流程所导致的持续存在的模拟到现实差距。本文提出一个统一框架，旨在解决上述局限，生成适用于实际部署的动态可行导航策略。首先，理论分析表明，模拟位置与实际机器人位置之间的跟踪误差随控制阶数增加呈指数衰减，这促使采用高阶控制输入作为DRL动作空间。我们针对差速驱动机器人开发了一种二阶控制公式，并辅以随机迭代线性二次型调节器（iLQR），该调节器通过散度最小化目标对策略进行预训练。其次，为避免相机-激光雷达融合带来的额外系统复杂度，本文引入一种仅利用二维激光雷达的基于聚类的人体追踪流程。根据空间邻近性和速度相似性对人检测结果进行关联，从而实现对附近行人的可靠区分，并通过时间聚合获得稳定的速度估计。第三，我们提出一种无偏残差门控模块，用以平衡基于反应与基于记忆的行为，同时处理时变的人群规模——这两者对社交导航均至关重要。所生成的策略KinematicRL能够持续提升运动学性能，并适应不同数量的检测行人。在真实环境中的实验表明，结合所提出的追踪流程后，KinematicRL可仅需最小改动即部署于真实的差速驱动机器人上。

title: Learning Unions of Convex Sets via Invertible Latent Decomposition for Path Planning
summary:
Collision-free path planning in cluttered, real-world environments relies on a representation of the collision-free space, and existing representations broadly fall into two
  categories. Explicit representations, such as unions of convex sets, can be plugged into optimization-based planners as hard collision-free constraints, but their parameters scale
  poorly with configuration-space dimension. Implicit representations, by contrast, are flexible and scale well to complex geometries, yet typically lack such guarantees. We bridge this
  gap with ILD (Invertible Latent Decomposition), a framework that jointly learns an invertible mapping and a union of explicit convex polytopes in the resulting latent space. Planning
  is carried out over these latent convex sets, and the invertible mapping decodes the resulting paths back to the original configuration space while preserving feasibility with
  respect to the refined explicit safe regions. We further propose Visibility-Guided Sampling (VGS) to keep the convex sets connected for path planning. Across 2D navigation, 6-DoF, and
  14-DoF manipulation environments, ILD achieves broader coverage, better inter-set connectivity, and higher path-planning success rates than prior baselines, with zero observed false
  positives after test-time refinement. On a 14-DoF bimanual manipulator, we further demonstrate real-time collision-free planning, with test-time refinement adapting to scene-geometry
  changes during real-world deployment on a single 6-DoF arm.
tldr: The paper introduces ILD, which learns an invertible mapping to a latent space where the collision-free region is represented as a union of convex polytopes, enabling efficient optimization-based path planning for high-DoF robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ILD，通过学习一个可逆映射将无碰撞空间表示为隐空间中的凸集并集，从而为高自由度机器人实现高效的优化路径规划。
summary_zh: 在杂乱的真实环境中进行无碰撞路径规划依赖于对无碰撞空间的表示，现有表示方法大致分为两类。显式表示（如凸集并集）可作为硬性无碰撞约束嵌入基于优化的规划器，但其参数会随配置空间维度的增加而显著扩展。相比之下，隐式表示灵活性高且能良好适应复杂几何结构，但通常缺乏此类保证。我们通过ILD（可逆隐式分解）框架弥合了这一差距，该框架联合学习一个可逆映射以及由此产生的隐式空间中的显式凸多面体的并集。规划在这些隐式凸集上进行，可逆映射将生成路径解码回原始配置空间，同时保持相对于精炼后的显式安全区域的可行性。为进一步确保凸集在路径规划中的连通性，我们提出了可见性引导采样（VGS）方法。在二维导航、6自由度及14自由度操作环境中，ILD相比现有基线方法实现了更广的覆盖范围、更优的集合间连通性以及更高的路径规划成功率，且在测试后精炼阶段未观察到任何误报。在14自由度双臂操作器上，我们进一步展示了实时无碰撞规划能力，其测试后精炼可在单6自由度机械臂的真实部署过程中适应场景几何变化。

title: Deformable In-Hand Slip-Aware Tactile Sensor with Integrated Velocity, Force/Torque, and Pressure Map Sensing
summary: This paper introduces a novel tactile sensor for in-hand manipulation with slip-aware control that integrates velocity, force/torque, and pressure map sensing into a single device with a deformable contact pad. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first sensor to combine these sensing modalities within a single compliant structure. The sensor features a deformable contact surface and can robustly track both flat and curved surfaces across a wide range of materials. Its performance is evaluated through a comprehensive set of experiments that highlight both its capabilities and limitations. The sensor is designed for rapid and low-cost fabrication using a combination of standard PCB manufacturing and rapid prototyping techniques.
tldr: A novel tactile sensor for in-hand manipulation that integrates velocity, force/torque, and pressure map sensing in a single deformable contact pad, designed for low-cost fabrication.
tldr_zh: 一种用于手持操作的新型触觉传感器，在单个可变形接触垫中集成了速度、力/扭矩和压力图传感，设计为低成本制造。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于手内操作的新型触觉传感器，该传感器具备滑动感知控制功能，将速度、力/力矩及压力分布图感知集成于单个带有可变形接触垫的器件中。据我们所知，这是首个将上述感知模态整合于单一柔性结构的传感器。该传感器采用可变形接触表面，能够稳健追踪多种材质的平面与曲面。通过一系列全面实验评估其性能，既展示了其能力边界，也揭示了其局限性。传感器采用标准PCB制造工艺与快速原型技术相结合的方式实现快速低成本制造。

title: Task-Aligned Stability Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving Hazard Detection
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. Furthermore, corruption families differ in failure direction: most suppress hazard detections via false negatives, while occlusion instead triggers false alarms, suggesting that benchmark design should account for asymmetric failure modes, not just overall instability rates. These results suggest that robustness benchmarks should include task-aligned stability measures in addition to embedding-level perturbation statistics.
tldr: This paper investigates whether corruption-induced embedding drift in VLMs predicts task-aligned hazard score changes for autonomous driving, revealing corruption-dependent and asymmetric failure modes that motivate task-aligned robustness benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究在自动驾驶中，VLM的嵌入漂移是否能预测任务对齐的危险分数变化，发现依赖腐败类型且不对称的失效模式，从而提倡任务对齐的鲁棒性基准。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）正越来越多地被用于自动驾驶场景理解，但其鲁棒性分析通常仅依赖于任务无关的嵌入稳定性。本文研究了由数据损坏引起的嵌入漂移是否能预测基于CLIP图像-文本相似性的任务对齐风险评分的变化。通过在BDD100K道路场景中施加受控损坏，我们将嵌入漂移与边缘漂移（即扰动下风险评分的变化）进行对比。结果表明，两者的关系高度依赖于损坏类型：某些损坏族表现出表征漂移与决策漂移之间的强耦合，而另一些损坏族尽管嵌入变化相对较小，却会引发危险性的决策不稳定性。此外，不同损坏族在失败方向上存在差异：大多数损坏通过假阴性抑制危险检测，而遮挡反而会触发误报。这表明基准测试设计应关注非对称性失效模式，而不仅仅是整体不稳定性率。这些结果表明，鲁棒性基准测试除嵌入级扰动统计量外，还应包含任务对齐的稳定性度量。

title: Modular Anthropomorphic Hand Design via Multi-Parameter Finger Benchmarking and Selection
summary: Designing anthropomorphic dexterous robotic hands remains challenging as the design space straddles morphology, actuation, and sensing properties, and performance metrics span both task-dependent and task-agnostic. Existing optimization methods are often unstructured or consider only a single performance metric, limiting systematic comparison and targeted refinement. While the design considerations of the entire hand are significant, the individual finger properties play a key role in dexterity. By developing a robotic hand platform where fingers can be modularly integrated into a full teleoperated hand, we propose that optimizing the fingers can significantly improve overall hand performance. This approach enables rapid screening of different finger-level prototypes through a number of quantitative benchmarks before their integration into the hand for task-level validation. Candidate finger designs (incorporating variations in joint, bone, skin, and sensor placement) are assessed using both mechanism-oriented and task-relevant metrics, which establish a quantitative link between component design and full hand embodiment. The framework is validated through the development of an anthropomorphic robotic hand with optimized fingers, demonstrating how these fingers enable performance improvements across tasks, including multi-object grasping and light bulb screwing.
tldr: This paper proposes a modular anthropomorphic hand design approach that optimizes individual fingers through multi-parameter benchmarking and selection, then integrates them into a full teleoperated hand to improve overall dexterous manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种模块化拟人手设计方法，通过多参数基准测试和选择优化单个手指，然后将其集成到完整的遥操作手中，以提升整体灵巧操作性能。
summary_zh: 设计类人灵巧机械手仍具挑战性，因其设计空间横跨形态、驱动与感知特性，且性能指标既包含任务相关参数也涉及任务无关参数。现有优化方法往往缺乏系统性结构，或仅考虑单一性能指标，限制了系统化比较与针对性改进。尽管整手设计考量至关重要，但单指性能对灵巧性具有关键作用。通过开发可实现手指模块化集成于完整遥操作手的机械手平台，我们提出优化手指可显著提升整手性能。该方法支持在手指集成至整手进行任务级验证前，通过多项定量基准测试快速筛选不同手指级原型。候选手指设计（包含关节、骨骼、皮肤及传感器布局的差异）采用面向机构与任务相关两类指标进行评估，从而建立部件设计与整手具身化之间的定量关联。该框架通过开发配备优化手指的类人机械手得以验证，展示了这些手指如何在多目标抓取及灯泡拧紧等任务中实现性能提升。

title: SAFER-Nav: Enhancing Safety for Visual Robot Navigation via Segmentation-Aware Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-based navigation models, particularly foundation models, generate viable trajectories from RGB observations alone.
